subject: math
description: Classify polygons as convex or non-convex using interior angles, diagonals, and overall shape behavior.
learningObjectives: Identify convex and non-convex polygons from drawings and descriptions
Explain that a convex polygon has all interior angles less than 180 degrees
Explain that a non-convex polygon has at least one interior angle greater than 180 degrees
Use diagonals to justify whether a polygon is convex or non-convex
Sort polygons by shape behavior using clear geometric evidence
